mentions.name: Qavvali
mentions.description: A wiki-style website serving as a gateway and introduction to Qawwali, a centuries-old predominantly South Asian music genre. It features content enrichments, family trees/lineages of Qawwali artists as a complex core feature, and a CMS/admin panel behind the site. The builder is socializing it to gather crowdsourced help with content and research.
mentions.audience: Anyone wanting to get introduced to the Qawwali genre
mentions.source_excerpt: Qawwali is predominantly south asian genre that is centuries old. My goal with this website is more like wiki, or a gateway for anyone wanting to get introduced to the genre. One of the main, and the complex feature that i worked on was building family trees/lineages. https://www.qavvali.com/
